notes: v27: Craig's 2026-09-13 QA fixes — (1) thin articles are failed crawls: server publish gate + client render filter exclude text below the 50-word floor from pages, refresh.json and feed cards; (2) video PDP no longer fails silently: ExoPlayer errors and load timeouts show an honest error with retry, failures are recorded, and videos this device can't play are excluded from the feed; video cards fall back to thumbnail_url when image_url is blank; (3) feed stability: background arrivals never re-render the visible feed — they buffer behind a persistent 'See N new stories' pill and swap only on tap (X/Twitter pattern), replacing the narrow MoreItemsBus-only rule.
